scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,desktop -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @devdeck/server" "npm run dev --workspace @devdeck/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @devdeck/shared && npm run build --workspace @devdeck/server && npm run build --workspace @devdeck/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @devdeck/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @devdeck/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @devdeck/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @devdeck/desktop
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
